method: Independently read all 298 original-English/Arabic pairs in source order with adjacent dialogue context, including opening, borrowed-memory visions, Riku/Xion conversation, confrontation, farewell, and framing scenes. Checked meaning, omissions/additions, negation, speaker/address pronouns, name consistency, idioms and formal subtitle register. No review-complete claim was generated from automated matching.
notes: Source lower-case nobody wordplay at 03968a00 retained as نكرة; upper-case Nobody class terminology elsewhere retained as اللا أحد.
Scientific dialogue about red light at 03990d00 translated faithfully from the game rather than rewritten.
No installation, launch, build or publication performed.
canonicalHashDefinition: SHA256 of UTF-8 text with CRLF normalized to LF. Existing reviewer hashes retain raw Windows bytes at review time.
